title: Sail With Pirates
author: Jim Gasperini, SD Separa (2022)
description:
IT IS THE YEAR 1684

You have traveled back to the age of pirates.

You are stading face-to-face with a pirate captain. He offers you a choice: join his crew or die.

You can sign the parchment and become a pirate or attempt to escape before he can catch you. Your decision may lead you to safty or leave you stranded in time!

ARE YOU READY TO FACE THE DANGER?

An unofficial adaptation of the 1984 Time Machine book by Jim Gasperini
